question: A charged body is touched separately with a dry glass rod and a wet wooden stick. Which one is more likely to discharge the body? Give reason.

options.A: The dry glass rod, because dry glass is a good conductor
options.B: The wet wooden stick, because moisture provides a conducting path for charge leakage
options.C: Both equally, because all solids conduct charge equally
options.D: Neither, because a charged body cannot be discharged by contact
